lessons.objective: Apresentar-se, dizer o nome, a origem e a idade em inglês.

phrases.target: I am from Brazil.

phrases.target: I am twenty-five years old.
phrases.pt: Eu tenho vinte e cinco anos.

phrases.target: Nice to meet you.
phrases.pt: Prazer em conhecer você.

exercises.explanation: Com 'my name' (sujeito de 3ª pessoa do singular), usamos 'is'.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'Nice to meet you'?
exercises.explanation: 'Nice to meet you' é usado ao conhecer alguém pela primeira vez.

lessons.objective: Falar sobre familiares e usar adjetivos possessivos.

phrases.target: I have two brothers.

phrases.target: My father is a teacher.

phrases.target: Her name is Julia.
phrases.pt: O nome dela é Julia.

phrases.target: We are a big family.
phrases.pt: Nós somos uma família grande.

exercises.question: This ___ my sister.
exercises.explanation: Usamos 'is' com 'this' no singular.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'I have two brothers'?
exercises.explanation: 'Brothers' significa irmãos do sexo masculino.

lessons.objective: Descrever a rotina diária e os horários em inglês.
content: I go to work by bus

phrases.target: I wake up at seven o'clock.
phrases.pt: Eu acordo às sete horas.

phrases.target: I have breakfast with my family.
phrases.pt: Eu tomo café da manhã com minha família.

phrases.target: I go to work by bus.
phrases.pt: Eu vou ao trabalho de ônibus.

phrases.target: I usually study at night.
phrases.pt: Eu normalmente estudo à noite.

phrases.target: I go to bed at eleven.
phrases.pt: Eu vou dormir às onze.

exercises.question: She ___ up at six every day.
exercises.explanation: Com 'she' no presente simples, o verbo recebe -s: wakes.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
options: I go to work by bus.
I go to work in bus.
exercises.answer: I go to work by bus.
exercises.explanation: Usamos 'by' + meio de transporte: by bus, by car, by train.

phrases.target: I like coffee in the morning.

phrases.target: I love playing soccer.

phrases.target: I don't like cold weather.
phrases.pt: Eu não gosto de frio.

phrases.target: My favorite food is pizza.
phrases.pt: Minha comida favorita é pizza.

phrases.target: I prefer tea to coffee.
phrases.pt: Eu prefiro chá a café.

exercises.question: I ___ like horror movies.
exercises.explanation: Com 'I' usamos 'don't' para negar no presente simples.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'I prefer tea to coffee'?
exercises.explanation: A estrutura 'prefer A to B' indica preferência de A em relação a B.

lessons.objective: Revisar o presente simples, o verbo to be e as perguntas básicas.
content: Verb to be: am, is, are
Present simple: I work / she works
Possessive adjectives: my, your, his, her
What time do you get up?

phrases.target: Do you speak English?
phrases.pt: Você fala inglês?

phrases.target: She works in a hospital.
phrases.pt: Ela trabalha em um hospital.

phrases.target: They are my friends.
phrases.pt: Eles são meus amigos.

phrases.target: I always have lunch at noon.
phrases.pt: Eu sempre almoço ao meio-dia.

phrases.target: What time do you get up?
phrases.pt: A que horas você se levanta?

exercises.question: ___ she like music?
exercises.explanation: Perguntas com 'she' no presente simples usam 'Does'.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
options: He goes to school every day.
He go to school every day.
He going to school every day.
exercises.answer: He goes to school every day.
exercises.explanation: Com 'he', acrescentamos -es ao verbo 'go': goes.

lessons.objective: Contar ações do passado usando verbos regulares e irregulares.

phrases.target: I visited my grandparents last weekend.
phrases.pt: Eu visitei meus avós no fim de semana passado.

phrases.target: She went to the beach yesterday.
phrases.pt: Ela foi à praia ontem.

phrases.target: We didn't watch the movie.
phrases.pt: Nós não assistimos ao filme.

phrases.target: Did you study for the test?

phrases.target: He worked late last night.
phrases.pt: Ele trabalhou até tarde ontem à noite.

exercises.question: I ___ to the cinema yesterday.
exercises.explanation: 'Go' é irregular: o passado simples é 'went'.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'She went to the beach yesterday'?
exercises.explanation: 'Went' é o passado de 'go', indicando uma ação concluída.

lessons.objective: Falar sobre planos e previsões usando 'going to' e 'will'.

phrases.target: I am going to travel next month.
phrases.pt: Eu vou viajar no mês que vem.

phrases.target: She will start a new job soon.
phrases.pt: Ela vai começar um novo trabalho em breve.

phrases.target: We are planning to move.
phrases.pt: Nós estamos planejando nos mudar.

phrases.target: I think it will rain tomorrow.
phrases.pt: Eu acho que vai chover amanhã.

phrases.target: I am going to study tonight.
phrases.pt: Eu vou estudar hoje à noite.

exercises.question: I ___ travel next month.
exercises.explanation: A estrutura correta é sujeito + verbo to be + going to + verbo.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'I am going to study tonight'?
options: Eu vou estudar hoje à noite.
exercises.answer: Eu vou estudar hoje à noite.
exercises.explanation: 'Am going to' expressa um plano ou intenção futura.

lessons.objective: Fazer pedidos, perguntar preços e pedir a conta.

phrases.target: How much does this cost?

exercises.question: I ___ like a glass of water, please.
exercises.explanation: 'I would like' é a forma educada de pedir algo.

exercises.question: Como você pede a conta em um restaurante?
options: Could we have the bill, please?
exercises.answer: Could we have the bill, please?
exercises.explanation: 'Bill' significa a conta do restaurante.

lessons.objective: Usar vocabulário de aeroporto, passagens e hospedagem.

phrases.target: Where is the check-in counter?

phrases.target: Can I take this bag as hand luggage?

phrases.target: The gate is on the second floor.
phrases.pt: O portão fica no piso superior.

exercises.question: I need to check ___ for my flight.
exercises.explanation: O phrasal verb 'check in' é usado no aeroporto e em hotéis.

exercises.question: Qual é a tradução de 'boarding pass'?
exercises.explanation: 'Boarding pass' é o documento que permite embarcar no avião.

lessons.objective: Revisar passado, futuro e pedidos educados em situações reais.

phrases.target: I went to Rio last year.
phrases.pt: Eu fui ao Rio no ano passado.

phrases.target: I am going to travel in July.
phrases.pt: Eu vou viajar em julho.

phrases.target: Could you help me, please?
phrases.pt: Você poderia me ajudar, por favor?

phrases.target: I would like to book a room.
phrases.pt: Eu gostaria de reservar um quarto.

phrases.target: Did you enjoy your trip?
phrases.pt: Você gostou da sua viagem?

exercises.question: ___ you enjoy your trip last week?
exercises.explanation: Para perguntas no passado simples usamos 'Did' + verbo base.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
options: I didn't go to the party.
I didn't went to the party.
I don't went to the party.
exercises.answer: I didn't go to the party.
exercises.explanation: Depois de 'didn't', o verbo fica na forma base: go.

lessons.objective: Expressar e defender opiniões com conectores e ressalvas.

phrases.target: I believe that technology helps us learn.
phrases.pt: Eu acredito que a tecnologia nos ajuda a aprender.

phrases.target: On the other hand, it can be distracting.
phrases.pt: Por outro lado, ela pode distrair.

phrases.target: I completely agree with you.
phrases.pt: Eu concordo totalmente com você.

phrases.target: However, there are some risks.
phrases.pt: No entanto, existem alguns riscos.

exercises.explanation: A expressão fixa é 'in my opinion'.

exercises.question: Qual expressão introduz uma opinião?
exercises.explanation: 'In my opinion' anuncia o ponto de vista do falante.

lessons.objective: Identificar ideia principal, argumentos e inferências em textos.

phrases.target: According to the text, the main problem is pollution.
phrases.pt: De acordo com o texto, o principal problema é a poluição.

phrases.target: The author argues that schools should change.
phrases.pt: O autor argumenta que as escolas deveriam mudar.

phrases.target: In other words, the plan is too expensive.
phrases.pt: Em outras palavras, o plano é caro demais.

phrases.target: The passage suggests a new approach.
phrases.pt: O trecho sugere uma nova abordagem.

phrases.target: What is the main idea of the text?
phrases.pt: Qual é a ideia principal do texto?

exercises.question: According ___ the text, prices are rising.
exercises.explanation: A expressão correta é 'according to' (de acordo com).

exercises.question: O que significa 'main idea' em um texto?
exercises.explanation: 'Main idea' é o ponto central que o texto defende.

reading.title: The Future of Work
reading.text: Remote work changed where we work, and artificial intelligence is changing what we do. Routine tasks are increasingly automated, while judgment, communication and learning quickly matter more. Companies expect professionals to explain their reasoning, collaborate across cultures and keep learning new tools. For language learners, this is an advantage: the ability to negotiate, present and disagree politely is now a core skill, not a bonus. The challenge is to practise these situations before they happen. A short conversation about a real project teaches more than a list of isolated words.

lessons.objective: Reconhecer e corrigir erros gramaticais comuns em inglês.

phrases.target: I have been living here for five years.

phrases.target: If I were you, I would apologize.

exercises.question: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
exercises.explanation: No condicional irreal formal, usamos 'were' para todas as pessoas; 'was' é aceito na fala informal.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
exercises.explanation: Com 'doesn't', o verbo principal fica na forma base: like.

lessons.objective: Revisar tempos verbais, condicionais e linguagem profissional.

phrases.target: I have worked here since 2020.

phrases.target: If I had known, I would have called.

phrases.target: In my opinion, we should invest more.

phrases.target: Despite the challenges, we succeeded.

exercises.question: I have worked here ___ 2020.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
options: If I had known, I would have called.
If I knew, I would have called.
If I have known, I would call.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have called.
exercises.explanation: O terceiro condicional usa 'had + past participle' e 'would have + past participle'.

lessons.objective: Usar expressões naturais para manter uma conversa fluida.

phrases.target: I see what you mean, but I disagree.

phrases.target: No worries, take your time.

exercises.question: ___ the way, have you seen my keys?
exercises.explanation: A expressão fixa é 'by the way' (a propósito).

exercises.question: Qual expressão mostra que você entendeu o ponto do outro?
exercises.explanation: Essa frase demonstra compreensão antes de responder ou discordar.

lessons.objective: Resolver situações reais ao telefone e em atendimentos.

phrases.target: I'm calling about my reservation.

exercises.question: Como pedir um favor educadamente?
options: Could I ask you a favor?
exercises.answer: Could I ask you a favor?
exercises.explanation: 'Could I...?' é uma forma educada e indireta de pedir algo.

lessons.objective: Soar mais natural com conectores, atenuações e expressões idiomáticas.

phrases.target: As far as I know, the store is closed.

phrases.target: To some extent, I agree with you.

phrases.target: We'll finish it more or less by noon.
phrases.pt: Nós vamos terminar isso mais ou menos ao meio-dia.

exercises.question: As far as I ___, the meeting is canceled.
exercises.explanation: A expressão fixa é 'as far as I know', no presente.

exercises.question: Qual expressão introduz um contraste ou ressalva?
exercises.explanation: 'That being said' introduz uma ressalva ou contraste.

lessons.objective: Debater ideias complexas com argumentos e contra-argumentos.
content: there is a strong case for...

phrases.target: The underlying issue is inequality.

phrases.target: I would argue that the policy is flawed.
phrases.pt: Eu argumentaria que a política é falha.

phrases.target: On balance, the benefits outweigh the costs.
phrases.pt: No geral, os benefícios superam os custos.

exercises.question: There is a strong ___ for changing the system.
exercises.explanation: 'There is a strong case for' significa que há bons argumentos a favor.

exercises.question: Qual frase expressa discordância educada?
options: I take your point, but I see it differently.
exercises.answer: I take your point, but I see it differently.
exercises.explanation: Reconhecer o ponto do outro e depois discordar mantém o debate respeitoso.

lessons.objective: Demonstrar domínio integrado de tempos, argumentos e apresentações.

phrases.target: I have been studying English for three years.
phrases.pt: Eu estudo inglês há três anos.

phrases.target: If I had more time, I would travel more.

phrases.target: In conclusion, the project was a success.

exercises.question: In ___, the project was a success.

exercises.question: Escolha a frase correta:
options: I have been studying English for three years.
I am studying English for three years.
I study English since three years.
exercises.answer: I have been studying English for three years.
exercises.explanation: O present perfect continuous com 'for' indica duração até o presente.
